text:
terry: Quick planning thread  we need a compact nurture + launch email for the benchmark webinar (next Thu). Objectives: high register rate, low image weight, clear CTAs. Who can lead?

maria: I got this. Plan: two sends for most cohorts (invite + reminder) and a micro retarget for people who opened but didn't register. Keep plain-text fallback.

josh: Proposed segments: new_signups_14d, trial_active_7d, lapsed_30d, watch_openers. Different subject/preview and CTA pairing per segment.

anya: I'll build the segments and exclusion rules. For watch_openers we do a single Day2 calendar nudge. Exclude if already registered or opted out.

lia: I'll create a lightweight hero (600x180 @60kb), a mobile banner (320x80), and a text-only template. GIFs only for trial_active. Will upload assets to #marketing-assets.

josh: Subject lines (ideas):
A) "Live benchmark: inference cost & latency, see the data"
B) "How teams cut inference cost by 3x  benchmark webinar"
Preview text: "Wed 10am PT  Live Q&A + demo"
UTM pattern: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bench_launch_3123`

maria: A/B test A vs B for new_signups. For trial_active test 1-CTA (Register) vs 2-CTA (Register + Read summary). Keep welcome email <=120 words; bullets 3 max. APAC send window 09:00-11:00 local.

ops-bot: seg-gen: segments created: seg_3123_new, seg_3123_trial, seg_3123_lapsed, seg_3123_watch. status=ready

terry: Cadence proposal: Day0 invite -> Day2 reminder -> Day5 final short cutoff for lapsed only. Trial_active gets a technical follow-up instead of Day5.

anya: I'll push the segment IDs and GA rules to the campaign and add the exclusion list (no send if registered).

lia: Asset ETA: upload by 5pm. I'll include alt-text and compressed png + plain fallback.

josh: Copy constraints: subject + preview, 80-110 words body, 1 clear CTA above the fold. I'll post copy variants by 2pm.

maria: Ops: can we route tracking events to the marketing dashboard? Need register, attend, demo_request, cpl_by_cohort.

ops-bot: tracking: events wired. dashboard ticket #MK-4221 created and assigned to sam.

terry: Metrics to watch: open rate, CTR->register, register->attend, demo requests, CPL. Also watch deliverability for the lapsed cohort.

maria: Nice. Small ask: include a short unsubscribe-safe footer and a calendar .ics link in Day0 for watch_openers.

anya: For retarget subject: "Still thinking about the benchmark? Quick calendar link + replay". Keep it conversational.

maria: Great. I'll set up the campaign draft and QA tomorrow 11am. Posting final cadence + links here after QA. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
